jaguar.name: Jaguar
jaguar.description: The largest cat in the Americas, known for its beautiful spotted coat and powerful bite.

redSquirrel.name: Red Squirrel
redSquirrel.description: Look near the trees! It has brown fur and a bushy tail.

mallardDuck.name: Mallard Duck
mallardDuck.description: Check near the water! You might hear it quack.

monarchButterfly.name: Monarch Butterfly
monarchButterfly.description: Look around the flowers. It has orange and black wings!

ladybug.name: Ladybug
ladybug.description: Search the leaves. It is small, red, and has black spots.

greenFrog.name: Green Frog
greenFrog.description: Look closely near the pond. It jumps high!
